failureAudit.highestLeverageDefect: The eval pipeline had become internally contradictory for ukmla-4965: the evidence packet required HRT context, while run-26/run-30 forced HRT to be omitted and the deterministic reviewer rejected any literal HRT mention. This caused all five sampled endometrial-cancer variants to fail despite NICE NG12 2026 allowing the referral rule when bleeding cannot be attributed to HRT.
failureAudit.fix: Align the evidence contract, generator instruction, and deterministic guard with NICE NG12: HRT may be omitted, explicitly absent, or explicitly resolved as not accounting for the bleeding; unresolved HRT context still fails closed. No clinical or launch gate was weakened.
